changelog: One-click self-update: the update dialog now has an '⚡ Update now' button that downloads the new app files from GitHub and installs them straight into your folder — no manual ZIP handling anymore (courses and settings are untouched; a backup of replaced files is kept).
The header version badge and the update checker now read the installed version live from disk, so after an update the app immediately reports the new one.
Hub-installed courses are properly marked as shared, so the admin panel can also remove them from the computer.
App update checker: a dialog now appears when a new version is released, with the full changelog and a download button.
Fixed the header '⬆ Updates' button — it was rendered as a cramped circle; now it is a proper pill-shaped text button.
Deleting a course in the admin panel now also removes it from the shared-hub git branch.
Sync no longer reports courses as updated when shared-exercises is empty or installation fails.
30 exercise types: audio, video, text, speaking and more (see TEST QWEN GEN demo course).
Shared hub sync via GitHub branch shared-hub.
Admin panel (Konami code) to publish/edit/delete courses in the hub.
Dark theme, search, offline file:// mode.
